name: What is the process for designing and building a walkway with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for designing and building a walkway with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation to understand your vision and assess your property. We then move to design planning, which may include CAD-supported layouts to visualize the proposed walkway and material selections. Once the design is finalized and permits are secured, our experienced team manages the construction, from site preparation and base installation to laying materials and final touches. This integrated design-build approach ensures a single point of coordination and a managed process from concept to completion, prioritizing clear communication throughout.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our walkway design and build process involves consultation, CAD-supported design, permit coordination, construction, and final touches, providing a single point of coordination and clear communication.
